description: Many high-scoring TMs implement Collatz-like functions. Systematically construct 6-state TMs that compute specific Collatz variants and analyze their halting conditions using number-theoretic tools.
mathematical_formalization: f(n) = {n/d if d|n, a*n+b otherwise} for various (a,b,d); TM halts iff orbit reaches fixed point
implementation_hypothesis: Generate TMs encoding Collatz variants with different moduli and multipliers; check which ones halt for all initial values in a range
experiment_seed: Enumerate Collatz-like functions with modulus 2,3,4 and check TM halting for initial values up to 10^6
